resources.string: Shizuku is needed to change access here
GrapheneOS only lets privileged apps change the Network permission. Install Shizuku to toggle apps directly, or tap an app to open its permission settings.
Start Shizuku with wireless debugging, then come back. Until then, tapping a switch opens that app’s permission settings.
Firewall uses Shizuku only to run “pm grant” and “pm revoke” for the Network permission.
Open Permissions → Network to change access for %1$s
This is a system app. Blocking its network access can break features such as updates, connectivity checks or location services.

Firewall is a front end for the GrapheneOS Network permission. When you block an app, its INTERNET permission is revoked and the OS cuts it off from every network. No VPN is used, so it works alongside any VPN.\n\nFirewall has no network access of its own. Changes are made through Shizuku with the shell commands “pm grant” and “pm revoke”, just like the toggle in Settings → Apps → Permissions → Network.
